html:
Orheiul Vechi is a historic site in a gorge of the Răut River in central Moldova, with a ruined Golden Horde town and Orthodox monks' cells cut into the cliff.

In the 1300s the Golden Horde built a town here called Shehr al-Jedid, with a mosque, baths and a caravanserai. After the Horde withdrew, the Principality of Moldavia built a fortress town on the site, called Orhei. Orthodox monks carved a cave monastery into the limestone, and a small church still stands on the cliff top. The site holds remains from Getic times through the Middle Ages and is the most visited historic place in Moldova. It is a World Heritage candidate.
sum: Orheiul Vechi is a historic site in a gorge of the Răut River in central Moldova, with a ruined Golden Horde town and Orthodox monks' cells cut into the cliff.
